name: religion
description: Gods, beliefs, rites, laws, symbols, orders, holy places, and magic

fields.Name: The Hearthmother
fields.Deity or Belief: A maternal fire deity protecting home, kin, hospitality, and honest labor.
fields.Rites: Share the first portion of every communal meal with a stranger.
fields.Commandment: No guest may be harmed beneath a welcomed roof.
fields.Taboo: Extinguishing another family's hearth without consent.
fields.Sacred Symbol: Three flames inside an open circle.
fields.Holy Place: The First Hearth, said to have burned since civilization began.
fields.Relationship with Magic: Blesses wards, healing warmth, food, and protection from cold.

fields.Name: The Open Road
fields.Deity or Belief: A path-god who teaches that movement, exchange, and curiosity prevent tyranny.
fields.Rites: Leave a marked stone at crossroads and carry news between settlements.
fields.Commandment: Offer directions and water to peaceful travelers.
fields.Taboo: Blocking a public road for private gain.
fields.Sacred Symbol: A forked road beneath a rising sun.
fields.Relationship with Magic: Supports speed, navigation, safe passage, and dimensional travel.

fields.Name: The Quiet Judge
fields.Deity or Belief: An impartial death deity who weighs memory, responsibility, and unfinished promises.
fields.Rites: Speak the dead person's deeds truthfully before burial.
fields.Commandment: Do not hide a death or deny the dead their name.
fields.Taboo: Binding a soul to its corpse.
fields.Sacred Symbol: A closed eye above balanced scales.
fields.Relationship with Magic: Permits funerary wards and communication with willing spirits, forbids coercive necromancy.

fields.Name: Lady of Tides
fields.Deity or Belief: A sea goddess of change, trade, storms, mourning, and safe return.
fields.Rites: Cast salt and a personal token into the water before voyages.
fields.Commandment: Rescue the shipwrecked regardless of allegiance.
fields.Taboo: Claiming ownership of the sea or denying burial to sailors.
fields.Sacred Symbol: A silver wave crossing a black moon.
fields.Relationship with Magic: Favors water, weather, divination, and transformation magic.

fields.Name: The Seven Smiths
fields.Deity or Belief: Seven divine siblings embodying invention, patience, repair, craft, fire, measure, and teaching.
fields.Rites: Present a useful handmade object at adulthood.
fields.Commandment: Repair before replacing and teach any willing apprentice.
fields.Taboo: Intentionally designing a tool to fail its user.
fields.Sacred Symbol: Seven hammers around an anvil.
fields.Holy Place: The Resonant Forge beneath Mount Orun.
fields.Relationship with Magic: Treats enchantment as craft requiring makers' marks, testing, and accountability.

fields.Name: The Green Pact
fields.Deity or Belief: Life is a negotiated balance among people, beasts, plants, decay, and seasons.
fields.Rites: Return part of every harvest or hunt to uncultivated land.
fields.Commandment: Take no population below its power to recover.
fields.Taboo: Creating life unable to reproduce or die naturally.
fields.Sacred Symbol: Leaf, fang, and mushroom joined in a triangle.
fields.Relationship with Magic: Welcomes healing and nature magic but distrusts permanent artificial life.

fields.Name: The Unconquered Sun
fields.Deity or Belief: A solar warrior deity representing courage, truth, discipline, and public justice.
fields.Rites: Confess one fear at dawn and face it before sunset.
fields.Commandment: Defend those who cannot safely defend themselves.
fields.Taboo: Secret punishment without accusation or witness.
fields.Sacred Symbol: A golden eye surrounded by eight rays.
fields.Relationship with Magic: Grants light, truth, courage, and power against undead or deception.

fields.Name: The Moon Weaver
fields.Deity or Belief: A shifting lunar deity who governs dreams, secrets, art, illusion, and identity.
fields.Rites: Create an anonymous work of beauty each new moon.
fields.Commandment: Protect harmless secrets entrusted freely.
fields.Taboo: Stealing another person's true name.
fields.Sacred Symbol: A crescent threaded by a silver needle.
fields.Holy Place: The Gallery Seen Only in Dreams.
fields.Relationship with Magic: Celebrates illusion and dream magic while condemning permanent theft of identity.

fields.Name: The Thunder King
fields.Deity or Belief: A loud, generous storm god of oaths, competition, rulership, and rain.
fields.Rites: Swear major promises outdoors during a storm or before struck metal.
fields.Commandment: Keep public oaths even when they become costly.
fields.Taboo: Whispering an oath so witnesses cannot hear it.
fields.Sacred Symbol: A split crown struck by lightning.
fields.Relationship with Magic: Empowers lightning, weather, voices, and oath-bound effects.

fields.Name: The Thousand Ancestors
fields.Deity or Belief: Families remain communities across death, and the living inherit both debts and wisdom.
fields.Rites: Maintain household name tablets and consult them on major decisions.
fields.Commandment: Leave descendants a better name than you received.
fields.Taboo: Erasing someone from the family record.
fields.Sacred Symbol: A branching tree filled with small faces.
fields.Relationship with Magic: Allows voluntary ancestral guidance, protective spirits, and inherited memory.

fields.Name: The Liberating Flame
fields.Deity or Belief: A revolutionary sacred fire that destroys bondage, fear, and unjust hierarchy.
fields.Rites: Burn a symbol of submission during yearly renewal festivals.
fields.Commandment: Help captives who ask for freedom.
fields.Taboo: Owning another thinking being.
fields.Sacred Symbol: A broken chain glowing red.
fields.Relationship with Magic: Breaks bindings, compulsions, prisons, and sometimes useful restraints.

fields.Name: The Perfect Measure
fields.Deity or Belief: Cosmic order is revealed through mathematics, proportion, contracts, and predictable law.
fields.Rites: Audit personal debts and correct false measurements each month.
fields.Commandment: Use one standard for yourself and others.
fields.Taboo: Altering records after agreement.
fields.Sacred Symbol: A compass inside a square.
fields.Relationship with Magic: Prefers runes, geometry, wards, contracts, and repeatable spellcraft.

fields.Name: The Nameless Mercy
fields.Deity or Belief: A hidden god teaches goodness without reward, recognition, or permanent institutions.
fields.Rites: Perform aid anonymously and never reveal it.
fields.Commandment: Help where gratitude cannot benefit you.
fields.Taboo: Building monuments to personal charity.
fields.Sacred Symbol: An empty white cloth.
fields.Religious Order: No acknowledged order; followers recognize subtle signs.
fields.Holy Place: Any unmarked grave repaired by a stranger.
fields.Relationship with Magic: Miracles become weaker when publicly claimed or credited.

fields.Name: The Devouring Cycle
fields.Deity or Belief: Creation, consumption, death, and rebirth are one sacred process without moral preference.
fields.Rites: Consume a symbolic part of what one destroys and plant something after funerals.
fields.Commandment: Waste nothing taken from life.
fields.Taboo: Preserving the dead indefinitely.
fields.Sacred Symbol: A serpent eating a sprouting seed.
fields.Relationship with Magic: Supports transformation and renewal, opposes immortality and undeath.

fields.Name: The Sleeping Mountain
fields.Deity or Belief: An ancient earth-being dreams beneath the world and rewards patience, endurance, and silence.
fields.Rites: Keep one day of complete silence during winter.
fields.Commandment: Do not answer temporary anger with permanent action.
fields.Taboo: Mining beneath consecrated peaks.
fields.Sacred Symbol: A closed eye carved into stone.
fields.Holy Place: The Cavern of the First Dream.
fields.Relationship with Magic: Grants stone, sleep, endurance, and prophetic dreams measured in years.

fields.Name: The Laughing Mask
fields.Deity or Belief: A trickster deity exposes pride, rigid authority, and lies through humor and reversal.
fields.Rites: Officials exchange roles with servants during the Feast of Errors.
fields.Commandment: Mock power before mocking weakness.
fields.Taboo: Punishing a joke that reveals a true abuse.
fields.Sacred Symbol: A two-colored smiling mask.
fields.Relationship with Magic: Favors disguise, luck, illusion, escape, and curses triggered by arrogance.

fields.Name: The Star Pilgrims
fields.Deity or Belief: Mortal souls originate among the stars and must learn enough to navigate home.
fields.Rites: Record one new observation of the sky each clear night.
fields.Commandment: Share discoveries that change humanity's place in creation.
fields.Taboo: Destroying astronomical knowledge.
fields.Sacred Symbol: A seven-pointed star above an open eye.
fields.Relationship with Magic: Encourages divination, gravity, light, and travel beyond the world.

fields.Name: The Red Communion
fields.Deity or Belief: Shared blood proves that all thinking peoples belong to one vulnerable family.
fields.Rites: Healers and leaders donate blood during public covenant ceremonies.
fields.Commandment: Treat another's wound before pursuing revenge.
fields.Taboo: Using blood taken without consent in magic.
fields.Sacred Symbol: Two hands joined by a red line.
fields.Relationship with Magic: Permits consensual blood healing and condemns sacrificial coercion.

fields.Name: The Door Beyond
fields.Deity or Belief: Reality contains countless worlds, and hospitality must extend to responsible visitors from each.
fields.Rites: Keep an empty place at major feasts for an unknown guest.
fields.Commandment: Judge outsiders by conduct rather than origin.
fields.Taboo: Opening a passage without preparing a safe return.
fields.Sacred Symbol: An open door filled with stars.
fields.Holy Place: The Hall of One Hundred Doors.
fields.Relationship with Magic: Regulates summoning, portals, banishment, and interplanar diplomacy.

fields.Name: The Crowned Serpent
fields.Deity or Belief: A god of ambition teaches that power is sacred only when continually proven useful.
fields.Rites: Leaders publicly defend one decision before critics each season.
fields.Commandment: Use authority to create achievements that outlive you.
fields.Taboo: Claiming rank without accepting its risks.
fields.Sacred Symbol: A serpent coiled through a crown.
fields.Relationship with Magic: Rewards domination, command, transformation, and dangerous tests of worth.
